Fortnite v43.00 Update and Treasure Hunters Mini-Season Scheduled for November 2026

01 Nov 2026, 02:58 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Editorial Desk · Source: timesofindia.indiatimes.com

Epic Games has announced server downtime for the upcoming v43.00 Fortnite update, scheduled to begin on November 1, 2026. According to the reported schedule, maintenance is set to start at 1:00 AM ET and is expected to last for approximately three hours, during which matchmaking will be disabled. Epic has noted that maintenance times could be extended if necessary.

Regional Downtime Schedules

The server downtime will affect players across different global regions at varying local times. Confirmed regional windows reported in the schedule include:

  • India (IST): November 1, 10:30 AM – 1:30 PM
  • US – Eastern (EDT): November 1, 1:00 AM – 3:00 AM
  • Europe – UK (GMT): November 1, 5:00 AM – 8:00 AM
  • Japan – Korea (JST/KST): November 1, 2:00 PM – 5:00 PM
  • Australia – Sydney/Melbourne (AEDT): November 1, 4:00 PM – 7:00 PM

Players are advised that these are estimated windows based on official timelines, and actual completion times may vary.

Treasure Hunters Mini-Season and Reported Collaborations

Following the completion of maintenance, the Treasure Hunters mini-season is slated to launch, featuring a pirate-themed update and a reported collaboration with One Piece.

  • Character Skins: Reported additions include One Piece characters Monkey D. Luffy, Portgas D. Ace, and Buggy the Clown, alongside Jonesy-Hop, Hope variants, Cuddle Team Leader (Sid), and Oscar.
  • Music and Events: Special event music announcements feature pirate-themed Hatsune Miku, Kasane Teto, Lil Uzi Vert, and A$AP Rocky.
  • Map Adjustments: Pre-views indicate the introduction of pirate chests and a remixed Anvil Square, pointing toward potential new map locations and loot spots.

*Reported Claim:* Epic has not officially confirmed whether all collaborative content will launch simultaneously, as some items or skins may roll out in subsequent updates.

Practical Implications for Players

  • Complete Quests: Players should wrap up existing seasonal quests and claim available rewards before maintenance commences.
  • Storage Preparation: Freeing up device storage may be necessary to accommodate the new patch download.
  • Official Verification: To verify updates and check for potential extensions to downtime, players can consult Epic Games' official status pages, social media channels, or in-game notifications.
